resources.string: Use a dedicated Supabase Free project with the AURA SQL migration installed. Only public client keys belong here. Changing projects signs you out; it does not delete your data.
Credentials go directly to %1$s. Your password is not saved by AURA. Creating an account may require email confirmation.
Request an email code, then enter it with a new password. The project owner must configure the recovery email code template in the setup guide.
